tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (463)༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom ma mo chen mo'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi zhang rin po che zhes 'gran gyi do med de'i man ngag bzhugs so/ // /
(463)༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom ma mo chen mo'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi zhang rin po che zhes 'gran gyi do med de'i man ngag bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (463)༄༅// phyag rgya chen po sgom ma mo chen mo'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi zhang rin po che zhes 'gran gyi do med de'i man ngag bzhugs so/// /

(464)༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings spros med bde chen ngang nyid las// thugs rje'i phrin las 'gro ba kun la shar// byin rlabs stobs kyis gdul bya grol bar mdzad// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dam chos snying po theg pa kun gyi rtse// bka' brgyud gong ma'i tshogs rnams gshegs pa'i shul// rje yi phyag len gdul bya 'dren pa'i lam// bla ma'i zhal gdams gsung bzhin yi ger bkod// de yang chos rje dpal ldan lha ri pa'i gdams ngag gi gtso bo// phyag rgya chen po lag bcangs su ston par byed pa'i thabs slob ma las can rnams la 'debs par byed pa'i khrid/ dwags po bka' brgyud thams cad kyi pha phog gi chos/ sems nyid rin po che gcer mthong du ngo sprad nas byin rlabs zhugs pas/ nang lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa khang nas rdol bar byed pa'i gsang lam dam pa/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi khrid 'debs pa'i lugs 'di yin pas/ de yang bla ma dam pa de nyid gdul byar gyur pa'i slob ma la sdom pa gsum gyi gzhi bting nas/ dbang gis rgyud smin par byas pa'i rjes la 'di bzhin du 'khrid pa yin no// de la bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o skol da lta dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po (465)che thob/ dbang po lnga la skyon ma zhugs/ rang dbang rang gis thob pa'i dus 'dir/ nam bzhag gtan gyi bde ba zhig sgrub dgos// de la dam pa'i chos byed dgos// chos byed pa la dad pa phun sum tshogs pa gcig med pa'i thabs med/ dang ba skye bar byed pa la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam zhing 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom dgos pa yin te/ de yang sngar skyes pa la ma shi ba gcig kyang med/ da gdod skye ba rnams kyang 'chi bar nges/ da lta yod pa rnams kyang gcig shi gnyis shi las thams cad lus mi srid/ lar ni skyes phan chad 'chi ba'i chos can mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid yin te/ mdo las kyang*/

sa'am 'jig rten mtho ris na// skyes nas la la ma shi ba// gang zhig khyod kyis de mthong ngam// 'on te thos sam the tshom za// zhes gsungs pas/ thams cad rub rub 'chi ba 'di 'jigs mo yin// de thag ring po zhig na yod pa ma yin te/ rang re'i steng du'ang rgyangs kyi mi yong mi srid pas/ nges par sang nang mo tshun chad la mi 'chi ba'i gding thob pa'ang med pa yin te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes// bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin// bdag ni med par 'gyur ba zhig /de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ (466)rang re yang 'chi nges par thag chod cing nam 'chi'i tshod mi shes/ na so gzhon pas gding sbyar mi gtub ste/ spyir 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pa'i stobs kyis rig gcig bu chung la 'chi/ rigs gcig byis pa la 'chi/ phal cher dar la babs nas rub rub 'chi yi yod pa yin mod/ rgas nas 'chi ba re re tsam yin/ khyad par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir tshe yi snyigs mar song bas tshe thung ba'i stobs kyis tshe mthar bskyol yang lo drug cu tsam re las mi thub pa thag chod pa yin mod/ de bas na rang re rnams kyang sang 'chi'am gnang 'chi'am/ sang phod 'chi tshod mi shes/ bsam pa brgya'i steng du mi phebs par ma bsams pa gcig gis 'ub kyis bsdus nas mig rig rig 'chi ba 'di 'jigs mo yin no// mdo las kyang*/ sang tsam 'chi ba'i dus shes kyang*// de ring nyid du bstun te bya// 'chi bdag bong chen de dag ni// nam 'ong shes pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ rang cag rnams kyang ma la skyes nas 'chi ba'i phyogs su zhag gcig pas zhag gcig nyer song*/ khar song bas kyang de ring nyer song*// de nye je nye la song ba ma gtogs pas bzung nas yod pa ma yin/ khar sang mi rtag de ring*/ de ring mi rtag song du 'gro// zla ba snga ma mi rtag phyi mar song*/ na ning mi rtag dus gcig du song ba 'di thams cad rang gi tshe la ma tshor bar rbad rbad gcod cing yod pa yin te/

mdo las/ chu klung drug pa 'bab pa'i rgyun// ldog pa med par 'gro ba ltar// mi yi srog kyang de bzhin no// song ba pas kyang ldog pa med// mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i// rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na// chu shing snying po med 'dra ba'i// lus can gzhan dag smos ci dgos// ces gsungs pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub pa chen po lta bu dang*/ bla ma grub thob gong ma rnams lta bu yang 'das shing gshegs na/ rang cag rnams rtag tu re bas ci phan/ kun gyi 'gro sa 'di rang yin// bdag kyang 'chi ba 'di mi thub// mchu ba de yang shags mi theb// longs spyod che yang bslu ru med// yul mkhar btsan yang mi thub/ lar tshe'i mthun (467)rkyen zad na ci byas kyang mi phan par khyod med thabs med dar gcig sdod dgos byas kyang yug gcig sdod pa'i bshol mi thebs par nor longs spyod mang po bsags kyang thams cad shul du bzhag nas rang de gcig pur gcer bu lag stong du kyur gyis 'gro ba yin te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ yun ring dus su bsags spyad de// rnyed pa mang po rnyed gyur kyang*// chom pos phrogs pa ji bzhin du// sgren mo lag pa stong par 'gro// ces gsungs te/ sgren mo lag stong du thag rul gcig gis hril gyis bsdams nas ham hril gyis bor gtong ba 'di 'jigs mo yin no// nges par 'chi ba la bsams na bsran pa'i glags cang yod dam/ nye ba dang 'khor g.yog mang po yod kyang tshab btang sa med/ mgor mi gtub 'grogs zla btang sa yang med par rang re gcig pu mar gyi gsebs nas spu bton pa bzhin du zhul gyis 'gro ba'i dus gcig byung tsa na/ bsags pa'i nor gyis mi stongs/ nye ba dang 'brel bas mi stongs/ sngar byas pa'i lag rjes kyis mi stongs/ tshe 'dir byas pa'i lag rjes kyis mi stongs/ tshe 'di'i mthun rkyen thams cad khres kyis bzhag

/rang re rnam smin gyi khur tsha khur nas 'gro dgos pa de ni nges par 'ong ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du// gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' bskor yang*// srog gcod pa yi tshor ba dag /bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la// gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan// zhes gsungs pas/ nges par 'chi nges/ nam 'chi tshod mi shes te/ dus la long med/ nges na 'chi ba la chos min pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi stongs pas/ de bsams la dam pa'i chos la 'bungs 'tshal/ de yang ma go ba rnams snyam na/ chos byas kyang 'chi ba ni yong*/ nam yang thams cad 'chi ba la snga 'chi phyi 'chi yin/ de gcig pus sdug bsngal bya rgyu ci yod snyam pa byas nas tshe 'di'i dbang du phyad phyad gtong ba rnams ma go ba yin/ mi 'chi ba ga na 'ong*/ 'chi (468)ba la skyid sdug gi khyad yod pa yin mod/ dam pa'i chos mi byed pa snga 'chi phyi 'chi yin zer te/ shi ba'i yul na skyid pa gcig med par gda' 'o// shi nas med du mi 'gro slar skye dgos te/ chos ma byas na ngan song gsum du skye ste sdug bsngal bsam gyis ga la khyab/ dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba na lus gshags pa dang*/ gtubs pa dang*/ mes sreg pa dang*/ 'tshod pa dang*/ brdung ba'i sdug bsngal bzod pa'i glags med pa bskal pa mang por myong bar bshad/ grang ba'i dmyal ba na yang*/ lus 'khyag nas chu bur brdol ba dang*/ gas pa dang*/ gyes pa la sogs pa yod par bshad/ yi dwags la bskres skom gyi sdug bsngal zas skom lo zla bar yang mig gis mi mthong*/ gal te srid pa tsam mthong zhing rnyed na yang gzhan gyis 'phrog pa dang rnag khrag tu 'gyur zhing*/ steng nas mtshon cha'i char bab pa la sogs pas slar sdug bsngal bskyed cing las ngan ma zad pas 'chi ru mi gtub pas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa gsungs/

dud 'gro la blun zhing gti mug pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ gzhan yang gcig gis gcig za ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ che bas chung za/ chung bas che za/ mang bas nyung za/ nyung bas mang za ba'i sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams kyi skyid shos mi la brten pa 'di rnams yin te/ 'di rnams la yang mi theg bzhin du 'gal/ mi nus bzhin du bkol/ spu 'bal/ sna 'bugs/ zho 'jo ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ rtag tu bkol zhing spyad nas mthar khres kyis gsod de/ mi rnams skyid na yang dud 'gro rnams kyi steng du 'ong*/ sdug na sdug ste dud 'gro rnams kyi steng du 'ong*/ rgas thug thug tu bkol zhing g.yog byas nas/ mthar shad mar shag gis phyes nas/ mig hrag gi dmar long gi btang nas za ba'i sdug bsngal de ma mthong ngam/ ngan song gsum na nam du yang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te/ mtho ris gsum na'ang sdug (469)bsngal dpag tu med pa yod par gsungs te/ lha la ltung ba'i sdug bsngal/ tshe zad pa lus kyi rgyan rnams ni rnyings// 'od rnams ni yal/ lha zla bo rnams kyis gles la bor/ 'chi bar ni shes/ phyi ma gnas ngan par lhung nas sdug bsngal myong ba ni mngon shes kyis mthong*/ sdug bsngal bzod pa'i glags med/ nya bye tshan la bsgres pa lta bu yod par gsungs/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal gsod pa dang*/ gcod pa dang*/ mthub pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab par yod par bshad/ mi la yang skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bo bzhi'i steng du/ yod pa 'tsho skyong*/ med pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa dang*/ dgra sdang ba 'phrad dam 'phrad kyi dog pa'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen byams pa dang bral lam bral gyis dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ khyad par du snyigs ma'i dus 'dir hor gser yig pa dang*/ mi dpon gdug pa/ khral 'u las dang*/ de la sogs pas gtser te/ bzang ngan med pa'i sdug la gtad de/ bzang ba bzang na sdug bsngal/

ngan na ngan pas sdug bsngal/ yod pa yod na sdug bsngal/ med pa med na sdug bsngal/ lar na 'khor ba 'dir skyes phan chad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ sdug bsngal gyi bskor zlog /sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid las ma 'das pa yin te/ byams mgon gyis/ rgyud bla mar yang*/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin te/ 'khor ba pa la bde ba med// 'di yi rang bzhin me bzhin no// zhes gsungs so// de bas na da lta mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus tog tsam 'dir/ 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo ma bzlog cing*/ nam bzhag gtan gyi don gcig ma 'grub na/ de nas mi zlog ste/ phyi ma gar skye mi shes pas des na dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di thob pa shin tu dkon pa yin te/ gyang 'jam po me long 'dra ba'i logs la sran ma (470)gtor na gcig kyang chags pa dka' ba yin par 'dug /de bas kyang mi lus thob pa dka' ba yin par 'dug /de yang me long ngos la sran ma gtor na gcig chags srid dam/ de yang mi chags thams cad lhung nas 'gro zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi nyid shin tu rnyed dkar gsungs// zhes pas/ rgya mtsho chen po'i steng na phar gnya' shing gcig 'phyor bcug pas/ lo brgya na rus sbal gcig rgya mtsho'i steng du mgo rdog pa zhig lan gcig 'ong bas/ rus sbal gyi mgo de gnya' shing gi bu ga dar tshud pa shin tu dka' ba lags par gda'/ de bas kyang mi lus thob pa shin tu dka' ba lags par gda'/ de'i phyir slob dpon blo gros mi zad pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis ni yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas thob par dka' zhing*/ 'jig par sla ba'i mi lus yud tsam thob pa'i dus 'dir 'khor bar mi 'khyams pa'i gding thob pa gcig rang gis byas na byar yod pas byed dgos/

rang la rang drin che bar byed dgos/ rang gis rang ma bslus pa zhig byed pa gal che bas/ ci nas kyang chos mi byed pa'i glags med/ chos byed pa la thog mar sdom pa dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ sngar thob pa de yin/ da 'khor bar 'khyams pa dang sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rtsa ba rang gi sems 'di yin/ 'di'i rang bzhin ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ shes pas sangs rgyas pa yin pas 'di'i rang bzhin shes dgos/ 'di'i rang bzhin ma shes pa cis lan na sdig pa ma dag pas lan pa yin pas/ sdig pa dag par byed pa la dang po yi ge brgya pa'i khrid 'di gal che bas 'di shin tu nyams su blang 'tshal// de yang dben (471)pa'i gnas su mtshams dang 'dag car la sogs pa dam spring gi byas la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste bsam pa 'di bzhin du bya/ a pa/ nga khar song phan chad ma shi bas nga re 'tshengs/ mdo med du de'u song nas 'dug /da ni tshe mjug lhag ma tog tsam yud tsam 'dir nam bzhag gtan gyi don cig mi bsgrub re/ dam pa'i chos bsha' ma zhig mi byed re/ da ni tshe mjug lhag ma tog tsam 'di tshe 'di'i dbang du gtang re/ bla ma dang dkon mchog dpang por mi 'dzugs re snyam du zhe gna' ling gi bskyal/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yud tsam gcig bsgom/ des le lo dang snyoms las su mi lus pa'i dgos pa yod/ de nas sems bskyed pa yin pas/ de yang sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas bya snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsams la/ ngag tu sangs rgyas chos dang la sogs pa'i sems bskyed lan gsum bya/ de'i rjes la rang yi dam lhar wal gyis bsgoms pa'i spyi bor mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkha' 'di la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/

g.yon dngul gyi dril bu dkur bsten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa ye shes sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa wal gyis bsgom/ de'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i gdan nya gang ba lta bu'i steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thug gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa yi ge hūm̐ dngul chu'i mdog 'dra ba dkar la 'tsher ba gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer phyogs mtha' dag tu 'phros pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa (472)sems can thams cad kyi don du bzhu bzhu sngab sngab sa phyogs mtha' dag nas bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bkug pas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu'i gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar babs pas sku lus dkar mer gyis khengs/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong gi sen mo'i nang na mar brdol bas rang gi spyi gtsug na mar babs/ phyi nas mar song phyi'i sdig sgrib thams cad sol ba'i khu ba chus ded pa bzhin nag nyil gyis rkang sor bcu dang gshang lam nas mar bdas par bsams zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa tshar stong tsam re bgrang ngo*/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba pra ya tstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya st+wa āḥ zhes pa 'phro gcod pa dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' de rang gi lus la chil gyis thim par bsgom/ thim pa dang lus sems khong nas shigs kyis gshib lhod kyis glod la con gyis zhog cig /rjes la bsngo bas rgyas thob/ de lta bu'i bsgom bzlas de ni/ spyir sgom chen pa bya ba dge sbyor byed pa la thun bzhir rbad kyis bcad de/ tho rangs nam sum cha tsam re yod pa'i dus su 'di snyam du bsam ste/

a pa/ nga gnyid ma pheb nas dgon pa 'dir 'ongs pa min/ gnyid ma phabs nas ri khrod du 'ongs ba min/ gnyid ma phebs nas mtshams 'dag sbyar byas pa min/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas ji tsam gnyid log nas yod/ des ma ngoms na da nyal ba gcig gis ngoms pa mi yong snyams pa byas nas/ yar hag gis langs nas dge sbyor la gong bzhin du zhugs/ tsha ba mi ran gyi bar du bsgom/ tsha ba ran pa dang*/ bsngo ba rnam par dag pa res rgyas gdab nas/ zas kyi rnal 'byor (473)dang ldan pas tsha ba bya'o// tsha ba thon pa dang mal du sur gyis zhugs nas/ dro mi ran bar du dge sbyor bya/ dro ran pa dang bsngo ba byas la dro bya/ dro thon pa dang yang mal du chil gyis sdod/ dgongs mo rgyun gtor mi ran gyi bar du dge sbyor la 'bad par bya'o// de nas gtor ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ba sogs pa'i dge ba'i las 'grub tshad bya/ gtor ma thon pa dang mal du sur gyis zhugs la srod kyi nam sum cha tsam du song song du mi nyal ba dge sbyor la 'bungs yin/ de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pa res rgyas thebs par byas la/ nam gung sum cha tsam zhig khams gso ba'i ched du lus gnad dang ldan pas gnyid log ste/ tho rangs la sogs pa gong bzhin dge sbyor la 'bung bar bya'o// de ltar srod tho rengs gnyis/ snga dro phyi dro gnyis te thun bzhi'i bsrang du bcug ste ma chags par bya'o// des zhag bskyel/ des zla ba bskyel/ des lo bskyel/ des mi tshe hril gyis dge sbyor la bskyel ba'i dgos pa yod/ de ltar thun bzhir gyis la yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas 'bungs shig gsungs/ da sngon 'gro bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di phyag len gyi gtso bo yin pas 'di bzhin du nyams su blang*/ de yang tho rangs la sogs pa sngar langs la 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa phreng bskor re tsam bgrangs nas/

rdo rje sems dpa' rang la thim pa yan chad gong bzhin byas la/ de nas rang gi mdun du me long gi maṇḍal lam/ sa'i maṇḍal lam/ shing gi maṇḍal lam g.yam pa la sogs pa gang 'byor ba'i maṇḍal la nas kyi tshom bu nyi shu rtsa gsum dgram ste/ rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom/ de'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu de'i rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu de'i rtsa ba'i bla ma nas/ ya gi drug pa rdo rje 'chang la thug bar bsgom/ nam mkha' (474)dang mthong yul thams cad bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma la sogs yul gong ma rnams thams cad sprin 'thibs pa bzhin gang bar bsgoms la/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa thams cad gnong ngo 'gyod do// byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol snyam du sdig pa bshags/ de na mthor gtong dmar gtong khyed rang shes so snyam du blo ling gis bkal ba'i rjes la/ maṇḍal de la dmigs pa'i rten tsam byas la maṇḍal gyi gzhi ma de nyid rgya mtsho chen po gser gyi sa gzhi dang bcas pa la/ dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab/ gling chen po bzhi/ gling phran brgyad/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gter gyi bum pa kha bye dang brgyad/ nyi zla zung gcig /rgya mtsho dang*/ gling dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs/ 'bru sna tshogs/ rta dang glang po che la sogs pa ste/ bzhon pa sna tshogs/ 'dod pa 'jo ba'i/ khrus kyi rdzing bu/ ma rmos kyi lo thog /rin po che gser gyis gang ba/ dngul dang mu men/ mu sa garbha dang*/ rin po che rdo'i snying po la sogs pa ste rin po che'i rigs sam/ bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpag tu med pa/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i khyad par yin te/ gdugs dang rgya mtshan dang ba dan dang*/ 'phan ring dang*/ dar zab kyi rgyan sna tshogs dang*/

rnga dang dung dang cha lang dang*/ pi waṃ dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya la sogs 'dod yon sna tshogs/ 'jig rten na gces pa'i longs spyod gser g.yu rta khrab gos snam gnag lug sha mar la sogs pa'i longs spyod kyis 'jig rten khams mer gyis khengs pa phul/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rigs sam bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa re res kyang nam mkha' khengs pa dang*/ mchod pa'i lda mo'i rigs mang po so so rang rang gi mchod pa thogs pa/ rin po (475)che'i rigs re re'i phung pos kyang nam mkha' la slebs pa/ dar zab la sogs pas khra chil la song ba dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa'i sgras sil sgra la song ba dang*/ lar ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du mchod pa'i rnam pas khengs par bsams la dbul lo// yid kyis mchod du 'os pa'i dngos po rnams kyang bsams la dbul lo// rang gi lus longs spyod dngos po thams cad la ma chags par phul ba'i rjes la/ mos gus chen po kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pa zhe thag pa nas snying khung rus pa'i gting nas tung gis byas la/ zhe thag pa nas gsol ba 'di bzhin du gdab/ 'o khyed kyis bdag gi rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad 'dug sa 'di rang*/ thun 'di rang*/ gdan thog 'di rang*/ skad cig ma 'di rang la byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin thun mong ma yin pa 'dug sa 'di rang*/ gdan thog 'di rang*/ thun 'di rang*/ skad cig ma dang po 'di rang la bskyed du gsol/ rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyang des 'gre'o// gsol ba bskyar zhing bskyar zhing zhe thag pa nas btab pas/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyis kyang dgyes pa dang bcas nas zhal gyis tog gis bzhes nas mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsung ngo*// deng lab rgyu sems can gyi don las med pa yin pa la/

snga ma phan chad gsol ba 'debs mkhan ma byung nas rdugs pa yin pa la/ da res bu khyod gsol ba 'debs na byin gyis rlab ces gsungs nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas byin rlabs thugs rje'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam zhing gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rjes ma bzod pa'i (476)stobs kyis rang la byin gyis brlob pa'i ched du/ nam mkha'i sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma la brgyud pa rnams la thim/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyang ya ki rdo rje 'chang nas gcig la gcig thim gcig la gcig thim nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma slob dpon rin po che sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo de rang gi spyi gtsug na rang la brtse zhing dgyes pa'i cha byed du 'od dang gzi brjid dang bcas nas bzhugs pa la/ shin tu yus che zhing 'dod thag nye ba'i bsam pas mos gus kyi gdung ba drag po bskyed la/ bu pha la mi re su la re/ bu phas mi skyob na sus skyob/ da lta nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes thal mo snying khar sgyur zhing bzhin smin phrag tu bsdus nas khong pa yus kyis brnangs nas/ gdong mchi mas gang ba'i gdung bas/ dung lhog lhog gis gsol ba btab pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal nas 'od gsol ba 'debs rin chog pa'i bla ma yin no// bu gsol ba thob cig gsung bar bsam zhing mchi ma ci 'ong byas la gsol ba btab/ thun gyi dngos gzhi gsol ba 'debs pa la bskyal/ 'phro gcod pa dang bla ma yang thugs rjes ma bzod pa'i stobs kyis/ rang la byin gyis brlab pa'i ched du 'od du ldem gyis zhu nas rang gi lus la chil gyis thim par bsgom/ thim pa dang lus sems khong nas shigs kyis bshig /lhod kyis glod la bzhag go /mi 'phro bar 'dug na/

mi 'phro ba'i bar du de ka'i ngang la bzhag /'phro bar 'dug na maṇḍal gcig phul la/ yid mchod 'bul ba dang gsol ba 'debs pa gong du bstan pa ltar de kho na la bskyar zhing bskyar zhing bya'o// mos gus bskyed la gsol ba gdab/ 'phro gcod tsa na bla ma rang la thim par bsam/ de yang bka' brgyud kyi byin brlabs 'jug mi 'jug dang sgom skye mi skye thams cad rang gi mos gus la rags las pas/ mos gus bskyed la mchi ma ci 'ong ci 'ong bya/ gsol ba skam 'debs la byin rlabs (477)kyang skam po las mi 'byung*/ de la sgom yang skam po las mi skye bas mchi ma ci 'ong ci 'ong bya/ mos gus kho na rkyang 'ded kyi lag len gyi mthil 'di kho na yin/ de chos kyi skad du thabs kyi tsha zer/ 'dir sngon 'gro zhes su btags pa yin/ gal che shos dag 'di yin pas/ zla ba phyed kyi bar du mos gus la 'bungs shig gsungs so// dngos gzhi'i man ngag ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ting nge 'dzin// stong pa nyid ces rgyal bas bshad// de ni sems ngo shes pa las// thob par 'gyur gyis gzhan du min// zhes pa dang*/ 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo las kyang*// sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs so/ sems zhes kyang bya/ rig pa zhes kyang bya/ rnam rtog zhes kyang bya/ dran pa zhes kyang bya ste/ don la nga yi sems nga yi sems zer ba mi dran dgu dran rig rig po 'di nyid kho na la zer ba yin/ 'di'i rang bzhin shes pa la bsten nas sangs rgyas pa yin la/ 'di'i rang bzhin ma shes pa la bsten nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin pas/ des na sems 'di'i rang bzhin shes pa byed dgos/ de yang chos spyi'i skad du shes rab kyi cha zer/ 'dir dngos gzhi'i man ngag tu btags pa yin pas/ 'di bzhin du nyams su blang 'tshal/ de yang gong du bstan pa bzhin du/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/

yi ge brgya pa 'dren pa nas maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa byas pa'i rjes la/ dad gus gdung bas gsol ba btab ste/ rang sems rnyogs ma dwangs su gzhug ces pa dang*/ brtag dpyad rab rib ma mang bar// ma bcos rang dgar glod la bzhag go /ces gsungs pas/ bla ma la mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa mchi ma 'dur gyis byung ba'i rjes la/ bla ma yang thugs rjes ma bzod de 'od du (478)zhu nas rang gi lus la chil gyis thim par bsgom/ thim pa dang lus sems khong nas shigs kyis bshig /lhod kyis glod la tsen gyis bzhag go /ched du gang yang mi bsgom/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid la// bsam gtan dri mas mi bslad 'tshal// zhes gsungs pas/ chos kyi sku sgom par 'ong ngo mi bsgom/ blo las 'das pa mi bsgom/ stong pa nyid mi bsgom/ skye ba med pa mi bsgom/ 'od gsal mi bsgom/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom par 'ong ngo ma bsgoms shig /'o na ji ltar bya na/ lus mi 'gul/ mig mi 'dzum/ 'das pa'i shes pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i shes pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da ltar ba la rtsis gdab gang yang ma byed par snang ba bkra lam me/ rig pa stong sang nge*/ shes pa rnal ma rjen khres se ba 'di nyid kho na la tsen gyis bzhag go /de yang rang babs su chil le bzhag go ma bsgrim par lhod de bzhag go /de la legs nyes kyi brtags dpyad ma byed/ yin min gyi the tshom ma za/ rnam par rtog pa spros te spros pa mang po'i rjes su ma 'breng ba/ tsha la dos thag chad pa bzhin du khres se bzhag go /sog phon phon thag chad pa bzhin du shigs se bzhag go /de yang shes pa rnal mar lhod de bzhag pas/ rnam par rtog pa snga ma ni 'das/ phyi ma ma skyes/ da lta ba glod pa'i bar 'di na/ sems la sems ma mchis ste sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ sems stong sang nge*/ sa le rig ge hrig ge rjen ne khres se ba 'di kho na la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya/

dbu ma rab tu mi gnas pa zhes bya/ 'od gsal zhes bya/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya/ rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya/ chos kyi sku zhes pa yang 'di la zer ba yin pas/ gcer re mthong nas me long zhig /'gro sar phyin nas ma 'khyams cig /de nyid mthong nas ma sgrib cig /gnas lugs yin no ma (479)bcos zhog /ces gsungs pas/ rang ngo tsir gyis bzung la rig pa dri ma med pa stong sang nge ba 'di kho na'i steng du ma bcos par glod la bzhag pas/ btang snyoms tsam du ma sgom rang sar bzhag na/ tha snyad tsam du sgom zhes de la btags zhes gsungs pas sgom zhes pa yang de la bya/ dge sbyor zhes pa yang de la zer/ ngo bo zhes pa yang de la zer te/ de kho na'i steng du ma bcos par rang babs su lhod de bzhag /de nyid las rnam par rtog pa mi 'phro bar 'dug na/ ji srid mi 'phro ba'i bar du bzhag /de ltar bzhag pa'i dus su sems zhes kyang bya/ rig pa zhes kyang bya/ 'gyu byed mi dran dgu dran 'di tol tol 'phro bar 'dug na/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces gsung pas/ phyi yul la 'phro 'am/ nang sems la 'phro 'am/ gang 'gro ba de kho na'i steng du glod la bzhag pas/ 'phro ba de nyid 'phro chad nas rang bzhin ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub par stong pa nyid du lhan gyis song nas nam zla ston gyi sprin med pa'i nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu dwangs sang nge ba zhig mi 'char mi srid de/ de yun ring ba la dga' bar mi bya/ thung ba la mi dga' bar mi bya/ phyag rgya chen po dgag sgrub gnyis dang bral ba'i gnad kas gsungs/ de ltar glod bzhag kyang sems mi gnas shing rig rig 'phro na sgom 'dod kyi blo dang ma bral bas lan pa yin pas/ de ltar ched du byed pa'i blo de dang phral lo// sems gnas ma gnas la dgag sgrub ma byed/ phu chu drag po brdabs kyin dwangs// dngul dkar me long phyis kyin gsal// rnal 'byor gyi sgom pa bshigs kyin bde// zhes gsungs pas/

ma bsgom par rang lugs su lhod de bzhag go*/dran rig rgya mtsho'i rnyogs ma 'di// glod nas bzhag na dwangs kyin gda'// zhes gsungs pas/ glod shes pa gcig pos chog (480)pa yin/ glod shes pa rab la sgom rab skye/ glod shes pa 'bring la sgom 'bring skye/ glod shes pa tha ma la sgom tha ma las mi 'ong bas/ rnam par rtog pa gang skyes pa de nyid kyi steng du 'jog pa de kho na gdams ngag gi rtsa ba yin pas/ rnam rtog tol gyis skyes pa de nyid ngos tsir gyis bzung la/ de kho na'i steng du lhod kyis glod/ yang gcig skyes pa'i dus su de nyid kyi ngang du glod la bzhag go /thun chung ba la grangs mang du bsgom/ thun chung bas ni skyon med la// grangs mang bas ni skyon mi 'thung*/ ces gsungs pas/ rnam rtog gcig skye 'dod byed pa dang*/ ma skyes tsam gyi gong nas klod/ de ltar de nas der glod pas dran rig 'di nyid kho na chos skur mi 'char mi srid de/ sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ ma bcos ma yengs rang sar grol// snang ba rang grol bde chen klong*// so ma lhug pa gyi na tsam// mi sgom pa yi sgom zhig bya// ces gsungs so// rnam rtog 'di nyid chos skur lhag gis shar nas rtog pa spang mi dgos pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ chos sku sgrub mi dgos pa zhig yin pas/ klod shes pa gcig pus chog pa yin no// de ltar glod pa dang rang sems ma bcos par bzhag kyang*/ sems mi gnas shing 'phro bar 'dug na/ ling gis bzhag la/ maṇḍal gcig phyis nas phul te/ gong du bstan pa bzhin du yid kyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul la/ mos gus kyi gdung ba chen pos thang ma chad kyi bar du gsol ba kho na gdab/ thang chad pa dang sems ma bcos pa'i ngang du khres kyis bskyur la bzhag go /rnam rtog mi 'phro bar 'dug na mi 'phro ba de nyid kyi steng du khres se bzhag go /de ltar glod pa dang bltas pas de nyid kyang rnam rtog tu gyu gyu byung na/

dran pa bkag pas lan pa yin pas/ rnam par rtog pa bkag pas mi khegs/ spangs pas mi spangs/ bkug pas mi khug /bzung bas mi thung*/ gzings las 'phur ba'i bya rog (481)bzhin// yul la 'pho ba'i sems mi bsdu// mkhas pas ba glang skyong ba bzhin// rnal 'byor shes pa yan du chug /zhes pa dang*/ ye shes gsang ba sgron me'i rgyud las/ 'dzin med rang gsal brten ma 'cha'// zang thal rig pa rjen par bzhag /ces gsungs pas/ bkag pa bzhin du 'phro ba zung ba bzhin du 'gro bas ched du gang yang mi dgag par gar 'gror btang bas/ gar yang 'gro sa mi rnyed/ lhan gyis 'ong ba yin pas ched du gang yang mi dgag /mi bsdu/ mi skyod/ ched du mi spro/ mi bsam/ mi sgom/ ma bcos par rang lugs su lhod de glod cing kho na bzhag pa'i ngang las/ skabs su dga' mi dga'i rnam par rtog pa thol thol skye bar 'dug na/ rnam rtog gang skyes pa de la cer gyis bltas te 'di dang po gang nas byung*/ da lta gang na gnas/ mthar gang du 'gro bar 'dug /de dbyings ci 'dra ba 'dug /gru bzhir 'dug gam/ sgor mor 'dug gam/ zur gsum du 'dug gam/ nar mor 'dug gam/ de la kha dog ci 'dra ba zhig 'dug gam/ dkar por 'dug gam/ dmar por 'dug gam/ ser por 'dug gam/ sngon por 'dug gam/ nag por 'dug blta/ gnas gang na gnas/ spyi gtsug na 'dug gam/ de bzhin du mgo dang ro stod dang*/ yan lag gang na gnas 'dug blta/ da lta gang na 'dug cer gyis blta'o// de ltar bla ma la mos gus bskyed cing sems ma bcos pa'i ngang du glad cing sems la blta ba de kho na la bongs skor du bya zhing nyams su blangs pas/ yin lugs zhig nang nas 'char bar gda' gsungs pas/ dus ji zhig tsam na 'di'i rang bzhin 'dir 'dug pa la nga sngar phan chad 'khrul 'dug /da ni 'di las 'chugs sa mi 'dug snyam du blo thag rbad kyis chod nas mchi/ de'i dus su rang gi sems nyid rin po che 'di kho na chos kyi skur lhag gis shar bas rnam rtog spang ma dgos te rang (482)sar grol/

stong nyid sgrub ma dgos te rang chas su shar bas/ rtog pa de nyid chos nyid du shes na/ chos kyi dbyings nyid gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// zhes gsungs pas/ mi dran dgu dran gyi rnam par rtog pa 'di nyid kho na chos kyi skur lhag gis 'char ba chos nyid yin/ de tsam na mig btsum pa la sgom re mi dgos/ snang ba bkag pa la sgom re mi dgos/ mig gi yul du snang stong zung 'jug /rna bar grags stong*/ sems bde stong yin te/ snang ba'i rang bzhin ye nas stong pa la// bshig bcom ming stod tsam la stong mi gdags// zhes gsungs so// mig gi yul na gzugs snang mod/ snang tsam nyid na rang bzhin ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pas snang stong dbyer med ces bya/ rna ba'i yul du sgra grags mod/ grags tsam nyid na rang bzhin ma grub pas/ grags stong dbyer med ces bya/ sems la sna tshogs 'char mod rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pas/ rig stong dbyer med ces bya/ de tsam na pha'i phogs thob bzhes bya ba yin/ bka' brgyud kyi byin brlabs zhugs pa zhes bya ba yin/ nor bu rin po che am 'phrag tu nud pa bya ba yin/ bla ma'i bka' drin lon pa bya ba yin pas/ de ma byung rin la 'bung 'tshal gsung ngo*// de ltar ngo sprod rgyas pa de rnams ni sngar yang yang gsung gin 'dug /dus phyis dngos gzhi'i man ngag ni/ don brgyud sangs rgyas na brdol bya ba yin pas/ bla mas ngo sprad mi dgos par rang la nang du lhag gis 'char ba yin pas/ bla ma la mos gus gyis la sems ma bcos par glod kyin bzhag go /'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems 'di yin pas/ 'di'i rang bzhin ci 'dra zhig 'dug tshol shog cig ces pa kho na gsung gi 'dug go*/bcom ldan thub pa'i bstan pa'i mar gsham 'dir// sa bcu'i dbang phyug zla 'od gzhon nu yi// sprul pa'i phrin las bod khams 'dir bkye bas// dwags lha sgom por dwags po lha rje (483)byon// mos gus lam gyis dad ldan khrid pa yis// slob ma grub thob dpag tu med pa byon// bod khams chos pas gang ba khong gi drin// bla ma de yis chos 'di'i srol gtod cing*// nyams su len pa'i bu brgyud bsam mi khyab// de rjes lhas rnam gnyis 'tshal dang gung thang du// sprul pa'i skyes bu skye med zhang sgom des// thugs rjes 'dus pa'i gdul bya snod ldan la// 'di nyid kho na'i 'khrid lung btab pa yis// mchog gi grub thob rtogs ldan mang po thon// sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar ba rje yi drin// bla ma de yis 'di nyid dar bar mdzad// de rjes spang gshongs lha ri'i dgon pa der// zhang gi sprul pa mnyam med chos kyi rje// 'gran gyi do med bla ma de byon nas// tshogs pa'i bu slob ma lus thams cad la// dam chos 'di nyid kho na btab pa yis// lo re la yang rtogs ldan zad med thon// gdul bya ma lus grol bar 'di yis mdzad// bla ma de yi phyag len snying po yin// de phyir 'di

lha ri ba nam mkha' 'od/ nyid gzhan las khyad 'phags shing*// bka' brgyud 'di yi gdams ngag gtso bo yin// des na chos kyi yang snying ḍā ki'i srog snying 'di// bla ma'i gsung sgros yang yang thob pa yis// blo la gsal zhing rjen par gnas pa des// brjed par phongs nas ma 'chugs ji bzhin bkod// snyan brgyud dmar khrid zhal gdams yin pa'i phyir// yi ger bris pas byin rlabs nyams srid de// gus shing brtse ba'i bsam pa rnam dag las// rang 'dod med pas nyes pa med par rigs// rje de'i bu chen yon tan smin pa yis// tshogs pa skyong ba'i brgyud 'dzin byung na yang*// gsung bzhin ma nor ji bzhin yod pa'i phyir// 'di nyid bzung nas gdul bya skyong bar rigs// pha de'i thugs rje'i lcags kyus rab bzung yang*// sngon sbyangs las dang brtson 'grus chung ba (484)yis// yon tan skyed med po la lus pa yis// sprang po bdag kyang 'di la 'bung ba 'thad// 'di bris 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis dang*// gsung sgros zur nyams la sogs nyes pa rnams// mtshan ldan bla ma de yis gtsor byas pa'i// ye shes spyan ldan rnams la bzod par gsol// 'di bris dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// ma lus dam chos 'di nyid nyams blangs nas// chos sku mnyam nyid thig le nyag gcig de// skye ba gcig gis mngon du 'gyur bar shog /byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i dpal lha ri ba'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i khrid 'debs pa'i lag len rnams/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung bzhin ma 'chugs par bris pa rdzogs so/// /de wa ku mā ras spang gshongs lha ri'i khar sbyar ba i thi/// /maṅga lam//
